items.title: Ethereum Foundation adds SEAL 911 co-founder to board as privacy focus grows
items.snippet: Pascal Caversaccio joins the Ethereum Foundation’s four-member board as the organization elevates privacy and security in its protocol strategy.

items.title: US arbitration giant launches specialist panel for crypto disputes
items.snippet: The American Arbitration Association’s Web3 Panel brings together specialists in blockchain, smart contracts, digital assets and autonomous transactions.
